# id: # Sailing methods real players use, numbers from the OSRS Wiki (see source). "?" = makes it, rate not on the wiki.

name: Sea charting
note: wiki ~10,000 xp/h at 22; one-off xp per task, bonus for finishing an area; crowbar from Prying Times (12), current duck from Current Affairs (22), diving tasks 38, weather station 57; all tasks need 78 (boostable); about 107,755 xp from quests and charting gets to 50
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Sea charting 2026-11-11

name: Courier tasks (early ports)
where: Notice boards at Port Sarim and Pandemonium (Musa Point from 10)
note: carry cargo between ports for xp and a loot sack; both hands free to take cargo; 2 tasks at once from 7; no early xp/h on the wiki

name: Courier tasks: The Summer Shore route
where: The Summer Shore (Ruins of Unkah tasks from 48/56)
note: wiki ~20,000 xp/h; skiff and oak sails recommended; 20,000 coins to start

name: Courier tasks: Rellekka route
note: wiki ~66,000 xp/h at 62 with only Rellekka, ~99,000 after 65 with Etceteria unlocked; empty the cargo hold before summoning

name: Courier tasks: Prifddinas route
note: wiki ~71,000-77,000 xp/h (low end used)

name: Courier tasks: Lunar Isle route
note: wiki ~130,000-160,000 xp/h (low end used); 5 tasks at once from 84; The Red Reef for the Red Rock to Lunar Isle task

name: Barracuda Trials (Tempor Tantrum, Jubbly Jive)
where: The Storm Tempor (Tempor Tantrum, 30); Backwater (Jubbly Jive, 55)
note: skiff only; wiki rates at Shark rank (Swordfish 19,342 / 64,746, Marlin 24,519 / 88,923); Tempor Tantrum needs iron helm, oak mast, linen sails; Jubbly Jive needs innoculation station and mithril helm
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Barracuda Trials 2026-11-11

name: Barracuda Trials: The Gwenith Glide
note: skiff only, adamant keel minimum; wiki Shark rank rate (Swordfish 113,538, Marlin 184,369, 198,119 with crystal extractor); rosewood hull (93 Sailing, 84 Construction) ~15% more
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Barracuda Trials 2026-11-11

name: Shipwreck salvaging
where: Shipwrecks across the ocean (small 15, fisherman's 26, barracuda 35, large 53, pirate 64, mercenary 73, Fremennik 80, merchant 87)
note: low end of the wiki estimate for each wreck tier (2 hooks from 53 up; better hooks give more, e.g. merchant 80,000-95,000 with dragon hooks); salvaging station from 42 makes it much faster; crystal extractor adds up to 14,286/h
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Shipwreck salvaging 2026-11-11

name: Deep sea trawling (giant krill, haddock)
note: sloop with two nets; also Fishing xp (15,000-25,000/h krill); rope net 56, linen net 65, cotton net 84 (Construction 73); haddock (Fishing 73) 21,000 at 65 and 44,000 at 84; wiki says estimates are provisional
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Deep sea trawling 2026-11-11

name: Deep sea trawling (halibut, bluefin)
note: sloop with two nets; also Fishing xp (33,000-38,000/h halibut, 37,000-43,000 bluefin at Fishing 87); 84 rates use a cotton net (Construction 73) and include the crystal extractor; low end of ranges used
source: OSRS Wiki Sailing training + Deep sea trawling 2026-11-11

name: Crystal extractor (passive)
note: 250 xp a harvest; wiki ~10,000 xp/h realistic (harvest every 90 s), ~15,000 max; stacks with charting, salvaging, trawling, trials or travel

name: Bounty tasks
where: Any port master; monsters at sea (Deepfin Point veiled kraken, Lunar Isle vampyre kraken)
note: kill sea monsters for bounty items; all doable at 80; mithril cannon recommended; wiki: mainly for drops and profit, no xp/h

note: One-off 300 Sailing xp; starts the skill

name: Prying Times (quest)
note: One-off 800 Sailing xp; gives the crowbar for charting

name: Current Affairs (quest)
